caption: The drawing depicts a metallic oil can with a wide, conical base and a narrow cylindrical neck. It has a long, thin spout extending upward and outward from the upper left side and a curved handle attached to the opposite side, arching from the top of the neck to the edge of the base. The main body of the can is colored in shades of grey, with areas showing a mix of brown, orange, and rusty hues, reflecting the worn and aged surface of the metal. The composition places the can centrally on a plain, off-white background, with soft shadows suggesting light from the upper right. There is no additional decoration or text apart from a handwritten signature below the object.
title: Spouted Oil Can
